roleContext.jobDescription: We are a general insurer writing home and motor policies through brokers and online. The Project Manager in the regulatory change office runs projects that implement new conduct and reporting rules across the policy administration, claims and finance systems, keeps the plan and RAID log for each project, reports progress to the change steering committee and coordinates user acceptance testing with the business areas. Candidates need at least five years managing projects in financial services and a current PRINCE2 Practitioner certification.

requirements.text: Has at least five years of project management experience in financial services.
Holds a current PRINCE2 Practitioner certification.
Runs regulatory change projects across several business systems with a maintained plan and RAID log.
Reports progress and escalations to a steering committee.
Coordinates user acceptance testing with the business areas.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Project Manager, Regulatory Change

## Experience

- Project Manager, Ashgrove Mutual Insurance (May 2022 to August 2026): ran the pricing-practices remediation project, which changed renewal-pricing logic in the policy administration system and the customer renewal letters, keeping the plan and RAID log in the PMO tool and collecting test sign-off from the pricing team.
- Presented a monthly status pack to the change steering committee, with milestones, budget against plan and the escalations the committee needed to decide.
- Project Manager, Linnet Life & Pensions (June 2020 to April 2022): delivered the redesign of annual statements for pension customers and moved policy document printing to a new supplier.
- PRINCE2 Practitioner, certificate awarded by PeopleCert in September 2021 and renewed through re-registration in September 2024.
- Project Coordinator, Linnet Life & Pensions (October 2019 to May 2020): kept the minutes and the action log for the IT service desk migration.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised RAID log and milestone plan from the pricing-practices remediation project, showing owners, due dates, the dependency on the policy administration release and the steering committee's decisions on two escalated risks.
